posts.post: the nightmare of trying to find a simple black crewneck without a visible logo, a weird collar, or a heavy brand tag itching your neck.
walking into a room and being the only person who didn't feel the need to broadcast a brand name across their chest.

most guys replace a piece the second it shows a little wear.

the best clothing hasn't even hit its stride until the third year.

we removed the internal care tags on the new batch just to stop them from bunching up. 

some details are only for the wearer to know.
